## What's new
- **Comments goal** (YouTube, Twitch, Kick): counts every chat message with at least the number of characters you choose (**Minimum characters per comment**, 5 by default). Leading and trailing spaces don't count, and each emote or emoji counts as one character. Example: a goal of 4000 comments of 10 characters or more.
- **Bits goal** (Twitch): adds the bits of every cheer in your chat. **No extra Twitch permission is needed** and you don't have to reconnect your account: the chat is read anonymously, like AC Multichat does.

## Good to know
- Comments and bits are counted from the live chat **while OBS is open**; what happens while OBS is closed is not added.
- Switching a source to comments or bits starts at 0. Change **Current value** to start from another number.
- Twitch reads the chat of the connected account. YouTube reads the live stream of the `@handle` and waits while the channel is offline. Kick reads the chat of the channel you typed.

## Updating
From 0.1.1 on, Goal Bar offers this update automatically (or use **Tools → Goal Bar: Check for updates**). From 0.1.0, replace the plugin folder by hand once.

## Downloads
| Platform | File | Install to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon, 13+) | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.5-macos-arm64.zip` | `~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/plugins/` |
| Windows x64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.5-windows-x64.zip` | `C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\` |
| Linux x86_64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.5-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/` |

The macOS bundle is ad-hoc signed; if macOS blocks it, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on the installed `.plugin` (see README).

All three packages are built and unit-tested in CI from the same commit.
